Name: Oracle Fusion ERP Separation of Duties (SoD) Matrix
Description: Automated Separation of Duties (SoD) matrix for detecting conflicting business role combinations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP (Financials, Payables, Receivables, Procurement, General Ledger).

Requirements.Name: Accounts Payable Creation vs Payment Processing Segregation
Requirements.Description: Prevents users from holding both AP Invoice creation/management and Payment disbursement roles to mitigate fraud risk.

Requirements.Name: General Ledger Entry vs Journal Approval Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures manual journal entries cannot be created and approved by the same accountant without independent review.

Requirements.Name: Purchase Order Creation vs AP Specialist Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures purchase orders and vendor invoices cannot be raised and matched by the same employee.

Requirements.Name: Security Configuration vs User Administration Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures application implementation roles are not combined with IT security management privileges in live operations.
